title: Gem requirement with no upper bound
description: Gemfile declares a `>=` gem requirement. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` gem requirement.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `>=` gem requirement.
limitation: It matches a `>=` gem requirement in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
